_comment: GravelHost - Schedule I (Schedule 1) dedicated server. Paid game + MelonLoader + DedicatedServerMod (ifBars, GPL-3.0) headless under Wine. Downloads via a shared Steam content account at install; the running server authenticates anonymously. Players connect by direct IP:port with the matching client mod.
name: Schedule I
author: santonu974@gmail.com
description: Schedule I dedicated server via DedicatedServerMod under Wine. Set S1DS_RUNTIME (mono default, or il2cpp) to match the client build your players use.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# GravelHost Schedule I - fetch and run the versioned installer from the repo.
set -e
curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iftekharahmed0427/Docker/main/games/schedule1/install.sh" -o /tmp/s1-install.sh
exec bash /tmp/s1-install.sh

variables.name: Steam User
variables.description: Shared content account that owns Schedule I. Used only during install. Locked; managed by GravelHost.

variables.name: Steam Password
variables.description: Password for the shared content account. Used only during install. Locked.

variables.name: Steam Auth
variables.description: Steam Guard code, only needed if the content account is challenged at install time. Usually left blank.

variables.name: Runtime
variables.description: mono (default, alternate branch) or il2cpp (default branch that players run; slow first boot). Changing this requires a reinstall.

variables.name: Steam Branch Override
variables.description: Advanced. Force a specific Steam branch. Blank uses the correct branch for the runtime automatically.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Display name written to server_config.toml on install.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Player cap, kept in sync with server_config.toml on every boot.

variables.name: MelonLoader Version
variables.description: Advanced. Pinned MelonLoader release tag. Do not use v0.7.1.
